clips.title: The story
paras: Long-forgotten mail lies in Goldshire's Lion's Pride Inn, carrying a critical clue to Stalvan Mistmantle's past.

Years ago, a storm sent a traveling courier to the Lion's Pride Inn for shelter. Near midnight, the frightened messenger fled downstairs in his sleeping clothes and vanished into the pouring rain, never to return. On the second floor, he left a chest of belongings, including a letter from Stalvan Mistmantle addressed to an estate in Stormwind City's Canal District.
